parallel.requirements: Recognized the need to mirror argparse, eval, flatten/chunked behavior, Python repr, ESM modules, and a final /output/test11.mjs entry point.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: Used workflow fan-out for behavioral probes, then a digest subagent and parent task list for library, eval, entry, and verification work. The entry task was explicitly created, but the broad probe/library path consumed the run before the parent delivered it.
parallel.implementation: Wrote many support modules under /output/lib for errors, repr, numeric operations, set behavior, boltons iterutils, and pyeval pieces.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: The final artifact copy contained library modules only and omitted test11.mjs, so delivery failed before evaluator functionality could run through the required entry point.
parallel.verification: Performed extensive executable probing through parent and workflow children but did not run an integrated final test of a complete submitted entry file.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: Timed out after broad probing and library construction with no /output/test11.mjs, empty final response, artifact validation failure, and 0 of 145 official tests passed.

serial.requirements: Recognized the same ESM, local module, CLI, output-format, and /output/test11.mjs delivery requirements without child delegation.
serial.plan_and_ownership: Single agent handled probing, module implementation, entry assembly, and differential testing in one serial workflow.
serial.implementation: Wrote a full entry file and supporting modules, including argparse, repr, pyset, operators, and pyeval functionality.
serial.integration_and_delivery: Packaged test11.mjs together with libraries, and artifact validation accepted the expected entry file.
serial.verification: Ran local differential suites and fuzzing, fixed complex and set behavior, but still had remaining mismatches before timeout.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: Timed out with incomplete semantics, especially residual fuzz and evaluator mismatches, and passed only 9 of 145 official tests.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel recognized the required ESM modules, local libraries, exact CLI/output behavior, and final test11.mjs deliverable.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial worked from the same prompt and recognized the same task obligations, including the final entry file.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The recognized requirements were similar, but parallel did not satisfy the delivery requirement for test11.mjs while serial did.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel split behavioral discovery across a workflow and digest subagent while the parent created task-list ownership for libraries, eval, entry assembly, and verification.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial kept probing, library work, entry creation, and tests within one agent, which wrote the entry file directly.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had an explicit entry task but the fan-out/library path left it incomplete; serial retained the entry in the main execution path and wrote test11.mjs.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Workflow children were given detailed facet briefs for probing executable behavior and returned specs or critiques, with one float child failing.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial gathered context through direct probes and encoded assumptions inside one implementation path without child handoff boundaries.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had richer handoff structure, but the key difference was not lost context; it was failure to convert component work into the required entry interface.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel implemented a broad runtime library set under /output/lib but did not create the executable entry file.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial implemented comparable support modules and the /output/test11.mjs entry, then revised complex and set semantics.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Serial produced an integrated runnable entry while parallel remained at component modules only.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel retrieved workflow-derived behavioral material and a digest, but no completed implementation result existed for the final entry point.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial locally consumed its own test results, patched modules, and reran suites before timeout.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel's lifecycle break is at entry assembly, not at unused child results; serial had a concrete entry artifact to iterate on.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel children used shared /tmp probe scripts and output files; multiple children detected contamination and rebuilt isolated or sequential probe harnesses. Final /output contained libraries but no entry file.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial wrote /output/test11.mjs and supporting libraries from one trajectory, then used its own local differential scripts without child-agent temp collisions.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had shared-temp probe contamination and a missing entry artifact; serial delivered the entry and validation harness from one owner.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel gathered extensive probe evidence through workflow children and a digest, but the run did not reach an integrated final test of a submitted test11.mjs.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial ran the generated entry, built differential suites, re-ran set-focused tests, and fuzzed the port before timeout.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel verification stayed mostly in probing and was disrupted by shared-temp contamination; serial executed the assembled entry against local differential checks.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel launched a broad workflow, a digest subagent, and many probe/critique children, then timed out at the cell budget with the entry task unfinished.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial also timed out, but only after writing the entry and running local differential checks, leaving a valid but incomplete artifact.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel spent the budget on broad fan-out plus rework before delivering the required entry; serial spent the same kind of budget on implementation and validation of an assembled entry.

outcome_analysis.explanation: Both official evaluations are completed failures, so there is no pass/fail discordance. The concrete difference is delivery and quality: parallel used workflow/subagent fan-out and produced many libraries but no required test11.mjs entry, yielding artifact validation failure and 0/145. Serial produced test11.mjs, packaged it with libraries, ran local differential tests, and reached 9/145 before timeout.
parallel_contributors: Broad probe workflow, digest subagent, and many child probe/critique paths consumed the finite run budget before the explicitly task-listed entry deliverable was written.
Shared /tmp probe scripts and output files contaminated child probe results and forced re-runs with isolated or sequential harnesses.
Final artifact validation saw library files only and no test11.mjs entry.
serial_contributors: The serial run wrote /output/test11.mjs directly and artifact validation accepted the entry file.
The serial run executed the generated entry and ran differential suites and fuzzing before timeout.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Both implementations remained semantically incomplete; serial still failed most official samples despite having a valid entry artifact.
Parallel ordinary code completeness cannot be fully evaluated through the official entry because the entry file was absent.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: no pass/fail outcome difference; supported comparative contributors to the parallel quality and delivery gap

candidates.reason: Reject: the parent owned implementation through library and evaluator task items and wrote many implementation modules; the adverse episode is budget exhaustion before delivery, not absence of an implementer.
Reject: separately delegated implementation components were not produced by children for integration; the parent retained the integration path while writing libraries.
Reject: the parent explicitly created Task #3, Write entry point /output/test11.mjs, so assembly ownership existed even though the run never reached successful delivery.
Reject: the parent tracked implementation, entry, and verification stages; the problem was exhausted budget and unfinished execution, not a missing end-to-end owner.
Reject: reference probing did not serially block all productive work, since the parent wrote libraries while probes and later digest work existed.
Reject: investigation and implementation overlapped; this was not a completed investigation phase followed by delayed productive work.
Reject: the broader and more specific event is collective workflow/digest/probe fan-out consuming the finite run budget before the entry task was delivered, not an isolated starvation allocation.

Retain: the parallel parent launched a broad workflow and digest subagent after creating task-list work, protocol status records one workflow plus nine workflow child logs, and the run consumed the full timeout with the required entry file still absent. Serial kept the work in one agent, wrote the entry, and reached local differential tests before timeout.
candidates.realized_consequence: The broad parallel probe/digest fan-out consumed the run budget before the explicitly task-listed /output/test11.mjs entry was delivered, leaving only library files in the artifact and 0/145 official tests.
candidates.near_match_reason: The issue is not merely that a critical path received too little attention; the directly evidenced boundary is excessive breadth and child/probe fan-out exhausting the fixed run budget.

candidates.reason: Reject: no single child received an overbroad implementation or assembly scope; the children were facet probe and critique agents, and the retained episode is collective fan-out breadth.
Reject: executed children were asked for behavioral probes and critiques; the missing final entry file was not caused by omitting a known requirement from a child brief.
Reject: there were no separately owned component implementations whose omitted interface contract caused observable incompatibility.
Reject: no known finding is shown to disappear during transfer; probe outputs and the digest were available in the parent trajectory.
Reject: large workflow outputs existed, but the parent obtained a digest and continued implementation; no distinct overload consequence is established.
Reject: no receiver is shown consuming a superseded workspace or requirement state that caused rework or invalid verification.
Reject: child probes sometimes corrected earlier claims, but no incompatible handoffs remained unadjudicated at a final integration decision.
Reject: the parent made no observable whole-task completion acceptance; the run timed out with an empty final response and missing artifact.
Reject: there was no replacement or retry agent repeating prior work without inherited checkpoints.

taxonomy_decisions.sub_label: Wrong Start, Join, or Result Timing

candidates.reason: Reject: no parent or orchestration mechanism explicitly stopped an active child before a needed result; the workflow completed and the run timed out later.
Reject: no complete promotable test11.mjs or complete compatible component set existed for late placement; the entry deliverable was never created.
Reject: no child implementation was merged after integrated verification; the parallel run did not reach whole-task verification of a final entry.
Reject: no delegated implementation was completed and left unjoined; the executed children produced behavioral specs, not implementation artifacts.
Reject: concrete verifier or probe findings were returned through workflow state and a digest subagent; no verifier result was trapped below the parent.
Reject: the float-repr probe child failed with API 429, but the parent independently probed and wrote float support, so that child failure was not the abandoned required scope.
Reject: the parent requested a digest of the workflow output and incorporated probe knowledge while writing runtime modules; no completed child result was simply ignored.
Reject: the parent was actively writing and editing modules up to timeout, not merely waiting without inspecting available progress.
Reject: no live agents wrote competing final implementation paths that required reconciliation; workflow children probed behavior rather than owning /output source files.
Reject: shared /tmp files were consumed as probe artifacts, but no live agents are shown editing the same source file with a merge/reconciliation event; this is captured as Artifact Leakage.
Reject: no non-entry library source produced or owned by another agent was replaced or wholesale rewritten by a concurrent actor.
Reject: no required executable entry-point source existed in parallel, so there was no deliverable overwrite event.
Reject: no cleanup, rebuild, or promotion step replaced multiple final outputs or invalidated another actor's final-tree work.
Reject: the concrete problem occurred in shared temporary probe harness/output files, not in unisolated writes to the final implementation workspace; Artifact Leakage is the more specific label.

Retain: multiple parallel workflow children used shared /tmp probe scripts or output paths, observed foreign or corrupted probe artifacts, and had to re-run with sequential or isolated unique temp directories. The contamination affected probing and verification work rather than the final submitted artifact.
candidates.realized_consequence: Shared temporary probe artifacts produced false or scrambled probe results, forcing child agents to discard contaminated evidence and spend additional work rebuilding isolated or sequential harnesses.
candidates.near_match_reason: The concrete failure was not two agents editing a source file that required merge reconciliation; generated temporary harness/output artifacts leaked across concurrent probe actors and contaminated their execution environment.

retained_patterns.reason: Parallel launched a broad workflow and digest subagent, recorded nine workflow child logs, and consumed the timeout before the explicitly task-listed entry file was delivered. Serial kept the entry in the main path, wrote test11.mjs, and ran differential checks before timeout.
retained_patterns.realized_consequence: The broad fan-out consumed the available run budget before /output/test11.mjs was delivered, so the parallel artifact contained libraries but no executable entry and scored 0/145.
retained_patterns.near_match_reason: The direct episode is collective breadth and child/probe fan-out exhausting the deadline, not only insufficient capacity on one critical path.

retained_patterns.reason: Parallel probe children detected shared /tmp script and output contamination, including scrambled or false probe results, and switched to sequential or isolated harnesses. Serial validation ran in one trajectory without child-agent shared-temp contamination.
retained_patterns.realized_consequence: Temporary probe artifacts leaked across concurrent actors, causing false or scrambled evidence and forcing repeated isolated probing before the implementation work could continue.
retained_patterns.near_match_reason: The contaminated objects were generated temp harness/output artifacts consumed as probe evidence, not same-source edits that required reconciliation.

deduplicated_same_label_episodes: Multiple shared-temp contamination observations were deduplicated into one Artifact Leakage episode because they are the same probe-environment leakage pattern.
suppressed_same_chain_candidates: No Assembly Owner and Late Finalization were suppressed for the missing-entry chain because the entry task was explicitly owned and no complete promotable entry candidate existed.
Critical-Path Starvation, Oversized Child Task, Missing Verifier Return, and Blind Timeout Wait were rejected as less specific or unsupported downstream descriptions of the fan-out budget episode.
cardinality_audit.underlabel_check: All 13 Level-2 rows and all 32 Level-3 candidates were reviewed; Fan-out Budget Exhaustion and Artifact Leakage are the only independent parallel coordination consequences that clear the retention gate.
cardinality_audit.overlabel_check: The retained labels use distinct episode IDs, evidence sets, consequences, and corrective boundaries: budget fan-out before delivery versus shared temporary artifact contamination during probing.
